steps.what: Read the student organization's actual proposal or activity question and relevant existing institutional guidance
inputs: student officers' actual proposal or activity question
existing institutional organization and activity guidance
outputs: teacher-read organization context and applicable guidance

steps.what: Meet with student officers, discuss their plans and give actual advice on the organization's activities and concerns
inputs: teacher-read organization context and applicable guidance
student officers' actual questions and responses

tasks.design: Configure a native reference view of existing student-organization guidance in {DOCS}. The teacher reads the real student proposal and advises the officers directly; no activity approval or safety decision is delegated to software.
tasks.previous_blocker: Applicable institutional guidance can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native bookmarks and document views can expose the relevant existing guidance.
tasks.still_hard: Student ownership and context matter more than a generic checklist.
tasks.human_edge: Help students reason through their plans without taking over their organization.

ambition.what: No extra organizations or approval powers assumed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native institutional-guidance views can shorten source navigation while student-organization advising remains a conversation.

assumptions: Shares are provisional, unmeasured work allocation. Student officers supply their actual question/proposal; institutional publishers maintain the guidance.
Only guidance navigation changes, not reading the proposal or giving advice. Missing guidance requires normal inquiry; existing equivalent views remove the gain.
No separate written report or approval instrument is established by this advising statement, so none is invented.
Gross provisional saving 1 minus 0.25 hour of reference-view upkeep gives 0.75 net.
unknowns: Actual advising questions and current guidance access
research_questions: Do organization advising cases repeat guidance navigation that a native view would remove?

already_counted.description: Read the actual proposal and relevant guidance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 0.75%; the actual advising discussion remains fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Search actual chemistry literature for the assignment topic and choose candidate readings
inputs: actual assignment topic and student preparation
existing scholarly-index and library records

steps.what: Collect the actual candidate source metadata and identifiers into the reference collection
inputs: teacher-selected candidate chemistry sources
actual publisher/library citation metadata
outputs: candidate source records with actual identifiers

steps.what: Read and evaluate the actual sources for chemical accuracy, level, relevance and student access
inputs: candidate source records with actual identifiers
actual source texts and institutional access information

steps.what: Arrange the reading bibliography, add any actual assignment annotations and check every final citation and access link
inputs: teacher's checked final reading selection
candidate source records with actual identifiers
actual assignment instructions

steps.what: Save the completed checked reading bibliography in the existing course workspace
inputs: complete checked chemistry reading bibliography

tasks.design: Configure native citation import and formatted export in {OTHER}, the scientific-library and reference-manager applications, to reuse actual source metadata in {DOCS}. The teacher reads and selects the chemistry sources and checks the final list before saving it in {LMS}; annotations remain teacher-written.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual metadata collection and citation formatting duplicate existing publisher records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference import/export can reuse real identifiers and citation fields.
tasks.still_hard: A relevant title can conceal unsuitable chemistry content or inaccessible prerequisite knowledge.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a reading sequence that develops the intended chemical understanding.

ambition.what: No longer bibliography or extra student reading assumed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: reference-manager import/export can reuse actual citation metadata without selecting or validating chemistry readings for students.

assumptions: Shares are provisional and unmeasured; metadata/formatting gains require actual manual work remaining today.
OTHER means scientific indexes, library catalogues and reference management. Publishers/librarians supply author, title, date and identifier; the teacher selects the actual sources in s1.
Missing metadata is corrected from the real source in retained checking, never generated. Existing import/export removes the corresponding additional gain.
Gross provisional saving 15.9 minus 1.4 hours of metadata/style upkeep gives 14.5 net. The final save is negligible and fully retained.
unknowns: Current reference workflow and metadata completeness
research_questions: How much real chemistry bibliography work is manual metadata handling after native import/export is credited?

already_counted.description: Check imported metadata and complete/check final bibliography and annotations

incremental.description: Maintain citation style and correct changed metadata/export mappings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 14.5%; existing reference automation or poor metadata may remove most gains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide chemistry consulting to government or industry

steps.what: Read the client's actual analytical-method question, sample context, test data and relevant technical references
inputs: client's actual method question, sample context and test records
actual technical-method references
outputs: teacher-checked consulting evidence and missing-information list

steps.what: Discuss the actual problem with the client and clarify objectives, conditions, limitations and intended use of the advice
inputs: teacher-checked consulting evidence and missing-information list
client's actual clarifications and objectives

steps.what: Analyse the actual method evidence and write and check the consulting advice, figures, limitations and intended recipient
inputs: actual clarified chemistry-consulting question
teacher-checked consulting evidence and missing-information list
actual source-linked analytical figures
outputs: complete checked chemistry advice and client recipient

steps.what: Send the exact completed checked chemistry advice to the intended client
inputs: complete checked chemistry advice and client recipient
outputs: client receives the checked chemistry advice

tasks.design: For an actual written analytical-method consultation, configure source views in {OTHER}, the analytical-data/reference applications, and figure links in {DOCS}. The teacher evaluates the chemistry, discusses the issue and checks the complete advice and recipient before the separate {EMAIL} send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Source navigation and repeated figure transfer can accompany actual consulting analysis.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source and figure links can reuse the client's actual evidence.
tasks.still_hard: Sample context, method validity and limits on inference require chemical expertise.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish a plausible result from one supported by the actual analytical method.

ambition.what: No expanded consulting authority or new laboratory service assumed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for client confidentiality and analytical-data access

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native source and figure links can reduce evidence handling in written chemistry consulting while scientific advice remains human.

assumptions: This is an unmeasured written method-review engagement, not a claim that every consultation creates a report. Oral-only advice has no figure-transfer saving.

OTHER means existing analytical-data/reference applications. The client supplies actual method, sample and result context; the teacher examines and clarifies it in s1/s2. Missing units, controls or provenance require inquiry.
Only navigation and actual existing-figure transfer change. No new experiment, inferred test result or automatic interpretation is assumed.
Gross provisional saving 4.7 minus 1 hour of source/figure-link upkeep gives 3.7 net. Existing equivalent links remove the gain; the send is fully retained.
Ordinary final checking is part of s3; any later edit invalidates the send gate. Consulting permission and confidentiality arrangements remain institutional.
unknowns: Actual engagement outputs and existing analytical document links
research_questions: Do real written consultations repeat source navigation or figure transfer that native links can remove?

already_counted.description: Read consulting evidence and analyse/write/check the advice

incremental.description: Maintain permitted source and analytical-figure links

approvals.approved_version: complete checked chemistry advice and client recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 3.7%; scientific analysis and client discussion remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.ambitious_version: Reduce source and citation handling while retaining student-organization advising, reading selection and accountable chemical consulting.
